note: PWA kill-switch. disabled:true makes every installed service worker unregister and wipe caches on its next check. minBuild retires builds older than that epoch-seconds value (same effect). forceUpdateBelow is softer: builds below it keep working but show a blocking 'update needed' sheet instead of wiping anything. Served with Cache-Control: no-store (see ui/vercel.json). minBuild is currently set to retire every build from before the 2026-11-04 stale-shell fix — reset it to 0 before deploying a rollback built earlier than that, or the rollback retires itself.
